youtube.title: This Map Is Lying To You #11 🌍 Which Is REALLY Bigger? #shorts
youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each shape slide to its real size 🌍 Did Nevada vs New Zealand get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow – number 12 drops tomorrow! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: total area in km² – Madagascar 587,041; Finland 338,145; Thailand 513,120; Germany 357,022; Mexico 1,964,375; Iran 1,648,195; Nevada 286,380; New Zealand 268,838 (countries: CIA World Factbook; US states: US Census Bureau).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
